source.command: python -c "from pathlib import Path; files=[Path('docs/AIOS-MANIFESTO.md'),Path('docs/AIOS-CONSTITUTION.md'),Path('README.md'),Path('docs/CHATGPT_PROJECT_CONTRACT.md'),Path('docs/AIOS-RENEW-BRAIN-TASK-AUTHORING-CONTRACT.md')]; texts=[p.read_text(encoding='utf-8') for p in files]; assert all(t.strip() for t in texts)"

python -c "from pathlib import Path; m=Path('docs/AIOS-MANIFESTO.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); c=Path('docs/AIOS-CONSTITUTION.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); refs=Path('README.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')+Path('docs/CHATGPT_PROJECT_CONTRACT.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')+Path('docs/AIOS-RENEW-BRAIN-TASK-AUTHORING-CONTRACT.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'Verified Useful Work / (Time + Tokens + Human Effort)' in m; names=['Human Intent, Evidence Truth','Separation of Authority','Bounded Mutation Authority','Sufficient Context, Reuse Until Invalidated','Probabilistic Intelligence, Deterministic Enforcement','Claims Require Evidence','Reproducible Canonical State','Correction with Continuity; New Intent with New Contract','Observable, Attributable, Replayable Automation','Bounded Autonomy, Maximum Useful Work']; assert all(n in c for n in names); assert refs.count('AIOS-CONSTITUTION.md') >= 3; assert refs.count('AIOS-MANIFESTO.md') >= 3"
